text:
Maya: Quick follow-up from the Pegasus postmortem — we agreed on three action items to reduce VPC peering flaps that led to tenant isolation. Posting owners + tentative timelines.
Sam: +1. Also flagging that the on-prem NAT edge was repeatedly dropping health probes; saw TCP RST spikes in the logs.
Jordan: Assigned: I will own the VPC peering stability playbook updates and the fallback routing recipe. ETA: Friday (end of week).
Elaine: I can take the on-prem NAT probe fix and the canary rollout for Pegasus test fleet. Plan: patch H/A probe logic, run staging validation. ETA: Tuesday morning.
Raj: I'll add a synthetic traffic job for the peering path and tune alert thresholds in the routing plane. ETA: Wednesday.
Maya: Action items summary:
- Jordan: update peering playbook + add a documented fallback routing policy (ETA: Fri)
- Elaine: NAT probe fix + canary rollout to Pegasus staging (ETA: Tue)
- Raj: synthetic test harness + alert tuning (ETA: Wed)
- Sam: verify model-variant pinning to avoid KV-cache invalidation during fallback (quick check)
Sam: Note — last incident included a fallback from r-xlarge to r-medium which triggered cache flushes. We should recommend pinning in the playbook.
Jordan: Will include model pinning and a rollback recipe with commands.
Elaine: Example probe tweak I'm proposing:
```
# nat probe config
probe_interval=5  # seconds
probe_retries=6
```
Sam: Also adding a small runbook step to check for asymmetric BGP withdraws on the Pegasus edge.
oncall-bot: Incident 1860000300 marked closed by @Maya. Follow-ups created and assigned. :white_check_mark:
Maya: Scheduling a 15-min sync tomorrow 10:30 to confirm progress. If you can't make it, please post status updates here.
Raj: Can do. I'll post the synthetic run results in this thread when complete.
Jordan: PR opened for the playbook edits: https://git.redwood/internal/infra/peering-playbook/pull/142
Elaine: NAT probe patch pushed to staging for validation: https://git.redwood/internal/infra/nat-probe/commit/0f4a8c
Sam: Tagging @Elaine @Jordan for inclusion in the weekly ops checklist and the Dedicated customer playbook.
Maya: Thanks all — please update this thread if any ETA slips or blockers pop up. :pray:
